subject: Best way to Upload a Binary File to Shiny Server

messages.author: 85e1cba7f82fd94e
messages.subject: Best way to Upload a Binary File to Shiny Server
parts:
Hi All,

Relatively new to Shiny (just installed Shiny Server over the holidays) - but am in the process of transforming my 'command-line' R-Studio Model into a very usable web site :-)

I'm at the point where what I'd like to be able to do is Upload a binary formatted (.FIT) file.  This isn't a common format - but one used for fitness data.
I don't want/need to be able to do any processing on the file via any functions in the server.R - as I have a java routine that I can call which will translate it to CSV,
which I can easily read/process from there.

I have been able to follow the Upload example - and am able to read CSV files and then store them where I like.

Just curious what the best way to handle a binary file would be ?

Thanks !
-Tim
